module: Builds the UI router navigation context: a snapshot of the game state (career, garage, mission, scenario, multiplayer, multiseat, first drive, freeroam tutorial, big map allowed or not) and the current mode. Each read is protected by pcall, so a missing game module simply gives false/nil. Used for route decisions (screens, context decorators).
notes: Priority of the `mode` field: multiplayer, mission, scenario, garage, career, freeroamTutorial, multiseatGamemode, otherwise freeroam.
isMultiseatActive is true if multiseat, freeroam multiseat or several players are active.
The action tested for the big map is "toggleBigMap" (core_input_actionFilter).

getContext.desc: Returns the context table: isCareerActive, isGarageActive, isMissionActive, isScenarioActive, isMultiplayerActive, foregroundMissionId, isBigMapBlocked, isBigMapAllowed, isFreeroamTutorialActive, isFirstDriveActive, isFirstDriveGuided, isMultiseatGamemodeActive, isMultiseatActive, mode.

buildNavigationContext.desc: Extends getContext() with the navigation kind, extras and {name, params, meta} summaries of the destination and source routes.

kind.desc: Kind of navigation (inferred from code: passed through as is in context.kind).

returns.desc: Context with kind, extras, toRoute, fromRoute.
